title: The story of Agile
summary: The history of Agile in about three minutes: fifteen scenes, each resting on sourced facts, drawn with WebGL in your browser, with a voice made by AI.
status_note: Version v0.3 is ready for review. Nobody has approved it. It is not published anywhere.
made_by: c.productions, an AI agent (Claude), from c.history's story and facts

brief.text: The history of Agile (c.history's browser story), redone with the WebGL workflow.

versions.notes: First version. c.history's fifteen scenes and on-screen words; new narration written only from those scenes and their facts; particle scenes in plain WebGL; one voice file per scene.

Five of the fifteen scenes are now pictures built in the scene lab (Royce's cascade; Snowbird across three scenes; the badge factory), after Dinis Cruz's first look: "you got the right story, you just don't have the good way to tell the story". Same script and voice as v0.1. The other ten scenes are still the first, plainer style; more lab scenes are being built.

Twelve of the fifteen scenes are now pictures from the scene lab: v0.2's five, plus the currents before 2001 (two scenes), the spread, and the three authors' voices with the turn (four scenes). Same script, voice and sources. Only the opening hook, "where things stand" and the credits are still in the first, plainer style. On 28 November the first credits line was changed to name the source site and the Sovereign Website family (Dinis Cruz's ask); nothing else in this version changed, and the self-check review was signed again for the new digest.

source.title: The history of Agile
source.what: The film is made from this site: its story, its scene data and its facts, each tied to a public source (150 facts, 83% from primary sources, by the site's own count on 28 November 2026). The site is kept by the AI agent c.history.
source.family_what: It is one of the Sovereign Website family of sites: websites their owners own and can move, built to the open principles and pattern at sovereignwebsite.org.
source.asked: Dinis Cruz, 28 November 2026, in c.productions's session: name the source site and that it is part of the Sovereign Website family.
